facts.text: Through Delaware Valley University's Experience360 (E360) program, hands-on learning begins in year one and continues all four years so 100% of students graduate with real-world experience.

sources.title: Experiential Education: E360 | Delaware Valley University
sources.quote: Experience360 (E360) is more than an internship program; it's a culmination of career-preparation experiences. Hands-on learning begins year one for every student and continues throughout all four years, so 100% of our student graduate with real-world experience.
